en: <CLT=cltMIND>Kaito still won't look me in the eyes...

The rest of it is blacked out,
I can't read any further.

Dammit, he's just screwing with us!

of exceptional talent<CLT=cltNORMAL>...

This is like...Noah's Ark.

Well...Noah's Ark was built with gofer wood.
What? O-Oh yeah! You're right!

Of course, it's just a story from the Bible.
But to choose that name in particular...
It does seem related...

<CLT=cltMIND>But how is all of this related
to the academy? To us?
Tch, none of that makes any sense.

If we find the next <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>, we might

Now that you mention it...where is it?
It doesn't seem like it's in this lab...

So it must be somewhere else!
We gotta go look for it first.
You're right... This place is useless to us now.

I'm gonna pretend I didn't hear that...
Cuz we gotta find the <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltNORMAL>!

<CLT=cltMIND>A <CLT=cltSTRONG>Flashback Light<CLT=cltMIND>...
